method: Bounded primary-source search, manufacturer portal inspection, clearance/decision text and indexed archival manufacturer excerpts. No outbound document requests sent.

source-fda-k260007.scope: K260007, Hudi HA 5 mg / HA 10 mg vaginal suppositories. Clearance restrictions are known; the complete package-specific manufacturer IFU remains missing.

findings.text: The manufacturer’s cleared indications explicitly state that these suppositories are not compatible with condoms. No condom-material exception is established for K260007.
findings.locator: Manufacturer 510(k) summary §4; PDF p.5; comparison table PDF p.7

findings.text: This clearance covers 5 mg and 10 mg HA formulations containing vitamin E, cocoa butter and semi-synthetic glycerides. The Revaree Plus predicate has different excipients; its package warnings cannot be transferred merely because both contain HA.
Hudi offers custom private-label formulas. Its public product page does not identify a complete US package insert and revision for these two cleared configurations.
findings.locator: Vaginal Suppository — Custom Formulas; Hyaluronic Acid Vaginal Suppository

sources.title: FDA K260007 clearance and summary
sources.method: Editorial inspection of publicly retrieved primary-source text/excerpts; indexed age can differ from access date. Full current IFU certification is separate.

sources.title: Hudi manufacturer private-label product page
sources.locator: Custom Formulas; Hyaluronic Acid Vaginal Suppository
sources.method: Direct public manufacturer-page inspection; product description is not a package IFU.

limitations: Complete US package instructions, warnings/contraindications, revision, marketed brand and catalog/UDI linkage are still unverified. The known condom restriction remains visible while this gap is open.
A generic HA-product label, a predicate label or an OTC-drug listing with similar ingredients is not accepted as K260007 labeling. Manufacturer document requests remain unsent.

source-fda-k260721.scope: K260721 Tornier Perform Advanced Glenoid. Cemented socket use and named humeral-system compatibility are documented; the complete Advanced-specific US IFU remains missing.

findings.text: The Advanced Glenoid implant is for cemented use only. Press-fit permission for named stemless humeral components does not apply to the glenoid socket.
findings.locator: Manufacturer indications for use; PDF p.4

findings.text: The clearance lists compatible humeral systems: Perform Stem, Stemless and Fracture; HRS and HRS Max; Flex; Simpliciti; and ReUnion. The exact component/catalog compatibility still requires the matched IFU.
findings.locator: Manufacturer indications for use; PDF p.4

findings.text: Clearance does not supply the complete contraindication or warning set. Earlier Perform Anatomic or Reversed Glenoid documents are not verified substitutes for the Advanced configuration.
findings.locator: K260721 device identity and manufacturer indications for use; PDF pp.1,4

sources.title: FDA K260721 clearance and summary
sources.method: Editorial inspection of publicly retrieved primary-source text/excerpts; indexed age can differ from access date. Full current IFU certification is separate.

limitations: The exact Advanced Glenoid US IFU, document revision, implant catalog/UDI references and complete compatibility table remain unverified. No generic shoulder warning set is presented as its manufacturer labeling.

Stryker’s US portal requires an exact REF, EAN/GTIN or KeyCode. No verified Advanced implant identifier was established; an instrument identifier must not be substituted. A document request remains unsent.

source-fda-p960053.scope: Braun-Cutter / Avanta CMC total thumb-base prosthesis, P960053. Historical manufacturer-insert excerpts and an explicit identity crosswalk were located; the complete revision-controlled label remains unverified.
models: Avanta CMC instrument sets — separate products

findings.text: A 2005 manufacturer ownership-transfer record explicitly links Braun-Cutter CMC (Avanta CMC) to P960053. The surrounding FDA file is indexed under K931588, a separate silicone trapezial implant; its submission number is not reassigned to this prosthesis.
findings.locator: Avanta ownership-transfer attachment, January 20, 2005; Braun-Cutter CMC / P960053 table row

findings.text: Historical Avanta CMC insert excerpts specify cemented use only and exclude active infection, inadequate supporting tissue/bone and skeletal immaturity. They warn of loosening, fracture or dislocation with excessive loading, and metal sensitivity.
findings.locator: Avanta Orthopaedics PRODUCT INSERT — Avanta CMC Prosthesis; English CONTRAINDICATIONS and WARNINGS; indexed excerpts only

findings.text: These archival warnings are not certified as current. S005 records a labeling change on August 9, 2016 without publishing the changed warning text in its decision statement.
findings.locator: S005 decision date, supplement reason and approval-order statement

sources.method: FDA-indexed primary-document excerpts (indexed March 2023). Full PDF retrieval was unavailable: web retrieval exceeds its size limit and direct download returned HTTP 404. Page, document revision and completeness were not verified.

sources.title: FDA P960053 S005 labeling-change decision
sources.method: Public primary FDA decision-text inspection; the decision statement is not the revised IFU.

limitations: Only FDA-indexed archival manufacturer-insert excerpts were obtained; full PDF retrieval was unavailable. The complete original insert, revision/date and S005 replacement label are still missing; this remains a label gap.
The March 31, 2023 FDA processing/index stamp is not a labeling revision or original approval date. The insert is not certified as the June 1997 original.

Avanta-branded instrument-set labeling and current generic Stryker hand-implant instructions cannot establish warnings for the implanted Braun-Cutter prosthesis. A manufacturer request remains unsent.

portal.observedRequirement: Exact REF, EAN/GTIN or KeyCode; no verified Advanced implant REF was established.
portal.rejectedSubstitution: Avanta CMC DI 00886385025780 is instrument set CMC-S, not implant labeling.
